mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% month-over-month signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator for overall economic growth, thus driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increased by more than 5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points within a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2 percentage points within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, which drives corporate revenues and profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS showed a sustained increase over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.3% month-over-month, it signals inflationary pressure and tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was above 5% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.3% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points within a month, it signals a strong labor market and potential wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k and UNRATE decreases > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 and UNRATE decreased by more than 0.2 percentage points within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in economic activity, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during a recessionary regime.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 1% month-over-month during a recessionary period.
